candidates.change_summary: Change decimals() to return a hardcoded value of 6 instead of 18, altering the observable return of P.decimals().
Insert a statement that directly modifies totalSupply before the return in totalSupply() to change the returned value.

Replace 'mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] += amount;' with 'mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] += amount + 1;' to alter the debt tracking, causing a different LPBalance update in burnSynth on any subsequent burn.
Delete 'mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] += lpUnits;' so the LP balance is never incremented, directly changing the observable balance.
Replace 'mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] += lpUnits;' with an addition of a constant 1, changing the stored balance.
Replace 'uint lpUnits = _getAddedLPAmount(msg.sender);' with 'uint lpUnits = 0;' so zero LP units are added to the balance.

Delete the require check in onlyPool modifier, removing the access restriction and allowing non-pool addresses to call mintSynth, which will produce different mapSynth_LPBalance values because the caller (now arbitrary) and its balance tracking will differ.
